main.content:
==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|en|at the least}}
* {{alter|en|at the very least}} {{q|emphatic form}}
* {{alter|en|atleast||univerbation|proscribed}}

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|at leste}}, from {{inh|en|ang|æt lǣstan}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{audio|en|en-us-at least.ogg|a=US}}

===Prepositional phrase===
{{en-prepphr}}

# {{lb|en|focus}} At a [[minimum]] or lower limit.
#: {{ux|en|I couldn't count them all, but I think there must have been '''at least''' 500 people in attendance.}}
#* {{RQ:Dickens Christmas Carol|pages=89–90|pageref=90|passage=So Martha hid herself, and in came little [[w:Bob Cratchit|Bob {{quote-gloss|Cratchit}}]], the father, with '''at least''' three feet of comforter exclusive of the fringe, hanging down before him; and his thread-bare clothes darned up and brushed, to look seasonable; and [[w:Tiny Tim (A Christmas Carol)|Tiny Tim]] upon his shoulder.}}
# In any event; [[anyway]].
#* {{quote-av|en|actor=w:Danny DeVito|role=Sid Hudgens|title=[[w:L.A. Confidential (film)|L.A. Confidential]]|writers=w:Brian Helgeland; w:Curtis Hanson|publisher=w:Regency Enterprises; distributed by {{w|Warner Bros.}}|date=1997 May 14|passage=You could even be discovered, become a movie star, or '''at least''' see one.}}

{{col3|en|
|mul:≥
|easy#Adverb
|easily#Adverb
|leastwise
}}
